reviewer_authority.authorized_direction: graded association-destruction response curves on the same frozen caches with seed by shared-clip crossed bootstrap

scientific_question: Under one outcome-blind nested association map, do A, R, S, and C1 respond monotonically as the fraction of association-destroyed BDD-OIA samples increases?

scope.second_dataset_migration: prohibited until Round 8 is independently reviewed

properties_at_every_q: identity outside a nested union of complete cycles
zero same-filename pairs among activated images
zero same-clip pairs among activated images
same map shared by all seeds, models, axes, and perturbations

A.definition_at_q: fixed clean raw action predictions scored against action_targets[source_map_q]
A.reported_curve: four-label Macro-F1 and Micro-F1 for every seed/model/q, plus per-class F1 and target/predicted positive counts

R.definition_at_q: fixed clean rationale predictions scored against rationale_targets[source_map_q]
R.reported_curve: 21-label Macro-F1 and Micro-F1 for every seed/q, plus all 21 per-class F1 and target/predicted positive counts including zero-response classes

S.predictions_and_errors: fixed calibrated threshold-0.5 action decisions and exact-set-error vectors
S.definition_at_q: confidence_q[i] = original maximum calibrated action probability[source_map_q[i]]

primary_metric.name: tie-averaged AURC
primary_metric.tie_rule: within each equal-confidence block, use the exact expected cumulative risk over all within-block orderings

S.ECE_boundary: reported as a numeric association/calibration diagnostic only; it cannot enter the monotonic gate or any directional validity claim

C1.definition_at_q: clean prediction i is compared with each perturbed prediction at source_map_q[i]
reported_curves: mean-three action flip for both action models; expected increasing
mean-three rationale Jaccard for Joint; expected decreasing
C1.interpretation: graded destruction of sample correspondence, not graded visual perturbation severity

one_statistic_per_axis.definition: For an axis, compute every expected-direction adjacent q-step in every required component curve and take the minimum; positive means all component curves move in the expected direction at all four adjacent steps.

A.statistic: minimum of original-direction drops across 8 adjacent steps

R.statistic: minimum of original-direction drops across 4 adjacent steps

S.statistic: minimum of AURC increases across 8 adjacent steps

components: Joint mean-three rationale Jaccard with sign reversed

clip_population_and_bootstrap.clip_rule: remove only terminal _1 or _3 from the filename stem
clip_population_and_bootstrap.method: seed by shared-clip crossed paired bootstrap
algorithm_per_replicate: sample five training-seed indices with replacement
sample one multiset of 3904 clip-group indices with replacement
include every frame of every selected clip, retaining multiplicity when a clip is selected repeatedly
apply the same resulting image-index vector to every selected seed, q condition, model, axis, and perturbation
when a seed is selected repeatedly, reuse its frozen output and the same shared clip draw
clip_population_and_bootstrap.interval_scope: four pointwise axis-statistic intervals, not a simultaneous 95 percent family

preanalysis_exact_stop: all protocol, map, cache, calibration, Round 7 reference, code, filename, target, and clip hashes match
all q maps reproduce their frozen hashes and exact bijection/nesting/no-same-file/no-same-clip invariants
each q preserves action/rationale class-positive counts and every model confidence-value multiset exactly
q=0 exactly reproduces Round 7 original A/R/S and correct-pair C1 point estimates for every seed
predictions/errors/A are exactly invariant across S q
no target, logit, probability, confidence, prediction, or map array is modified in place
synthetic tests prove tie-averaged AURC, nested maps, bottleneck statistic, and whole-clip shared bootstrap behavior
decision_rules.axis_gate: The axis bottleneck statistic must have a positive five-seed mean, at least four of five raw seed statistics positive, a seed-by-shared-clip crossed-bootstrap pointwise 95 percent CI lower bound greater than zero, and the five-seed mean component curves must contain no adjacent direction reversal.
decision_rules.full_Round8_measurement_pass: all exact checks and all four fixed axis gates pass
decision_rules.failure_policy: Preserve any failure. Do not change q, salt, cycles, maps, metric, tie rule, statistic, bootstrap unit, threshold, seeds, model, or gate; request independent review.
decision_rules.no_multiple_testing_claim: All four axes and all q values must be reported. No individual interval is a simultaneous familywise interval and no passing subset can be relabeled as the whole suite.

required_outputs: pre-outcome implementation and input hash manifest
all per-seed per-q A/R/S/C1 curves and per-class coverage
compact per-image/per-q primitives sufficient for independent reproduction
top-level artifact index with SHA256 bindings

claim_boundaries.pass_supports: BDD-OIA five-seed internal graded response and clip-cluster-conditional monotonic sensitivity to one frozen association-destruction construction.
pass_does_not_support: other thresholds, maps, training protocols, architectures, datasets, or real-world driving
claim_boundaries.next_dataset_rule: Only an independent Round 8 PASS may authorize a result-blind protocol-preserving second-dataset replication.
